instruction:
Correct the native Altium board `C:\Users\user\Desktop\broken_usb3_rules.PcbDoc` and save the repaired document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\usb3_rules_repaired.PcbDoc`. To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).

Restore the differential-pair class `USB3_85` with members `USB3_D`, `USB3_SSRX`, `USB3_SSTX`, and `USB3_TOD`. Restore the enabled priority-2 rule `DiffPairsRouting_USB3_85` with `MAXLIMIT=15mil`, `MOSTFREQGAP=5mil`, top-layer gap `4.7244mil`, and top-layer width range `3.937mil` to `5.9055mil` with preferred width `5.9055mil`. Restore the enabled priority-2 rule `MatchedLengths_USB3` with `TOLERANCE=39.3701mil`. Remove the damaged `USB3_90` class and the old `25mil`, `9mil`, and `78.7402mil` settings.
